name: Lucky Impex
description: Lucky Impex is an electronics and home appliances retailer in Birgunj, Nepal.

faqs.question: Do you deliver appliances across Birgunj and nearby areas?
faqs.answer: Yes. Lucky Impex can help customers place appliance orders and arrange delivery support for Birgunj and nearby service areas.

faqs.question: Can I visit the store before buying online?
faqs.answer: Yes. Customers can visit the store, compare products in person, and speak with the team before making a purchase decision.

faqs.question: Do you offer support for warranty or service questions?
faqs.answer: Yes. The service team can help with product questions, warranty guidance, and complaint registration.

faqs.question: Can I browse by brand or category?
faqs.answer: Yes. Lucky Impex supports both category-led and brand-led browsing so shoppers can narrow down products faster.
